description: Lab result carrying a laboratory's local abnormality flag verbatim alongside a ratified reading
notes: health v2.7. ZQ7 is a laboratory's local flag and is in neither bound value set. Before v2.7 an importer had two options and both lost: drop it, or write it to health:interpretation where it then failed the sh:in. The pair states the ratified reading (A, Abnormal) for a consumer that reads only the bound property, and keeps what the source actually said for one that needs it. The property is deliberately unconstrained -- no value set, no pattern -- because constraining a verbatim carbon copy recreates the loss it exists to prevent.
